vision: Owls have very good vision in the dark.

decision: It was a hard decision, but I chose the red coat.

division: Division is how we share twenty biscuits between four friends.

television: Please turn the television down, it is too loud!

confusion: The map was upside down, which caused lots of confusion.

explosion: The volcano in our science model made a fizzy explosion!

conclusion: At the conclusion of the film, everyone clapped.

collision: Did you see the collision of the two toy trains?

supervision: Little children need adult supervision at the park.
We can only use the oven with a grown-up's supervision.
Under supervision from my gran, I stirred the cake mix.
revision: I did some revision for my spelling test tonight.
Going over every page twice was good revision for the quiz!
Do you do revision by reading your notes once more?
